nodes.description: Private storage string holding the human-readable contract version; written by setContractVersion and read by getContractVersion.
Role constant keccak256("PAUSER_ROLE") gating pause() and unpause().
Role constant keccak256("MINTER_ROLE") gating privileged token minting.
Role constant keccak256("UPGRADER_ROLE") gating proxy upgrades and contract-version writes.
Role constant keccak256("APPROVER_ROLE") declared but never used to gate any function.
ERC20 balance mapping of the upgradeable token implementation.
Nested ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Total token supply, increased by _mint.
AccessControl mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role membership and admin roles.
Pausable flag read by the whenNotPaused modifier on _beforeTokenTransfer.
Initializable guard flag preventing re-invocation of initialize().
Public protected initializer: sets token metadata, grants all roles to msg.sender and mints 55555555555e18 tokens to msg.sender.
Pauses transfers; restricted to PAUSER_ROLE.
Unpauses transfers; restricted to PAUSER_ROLE.
External privileged mint(address to, uint256 amount); restricted to MINTER_ROLE, calls internal _mint with arbitrary recipient.
ERC20 hook overridden with whenNotPaused; executed on every transfer, mint and burn.
UUPS upgrade authorisation hook; restricted to UPGRADER_ROLE, body empty.
Writes an arbitrary caller-supplied string into _contractVersion; restricted to UPGRADER_ROLE.
Unauthenticated view returning the stored _contractVersion string.
ERC20 transfer of msg.sender balances; delegates to internal _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom; reads allowance, then performs an unchecked allowance subtraction.
ERC20 approve; writes the caller's allowance entry.
Internal balance-moving routine with unchecked balance subtraction and hook callbacks.
Internal supply-increasing routine invoked by initialize and mint.
AccessControlEnumerable grantRole; admin-gated role assignment that writes _roles.
AccessControlEnumerable revokeRole; admin-gated role removal that writes _roles.
Internal role verification used by the onlyRole modifier on all privileged functions.
UUPS external upgrade entrypoint; called by anyone through the proxy, delegates authority to _authorizeUpgrade and performs a delegatecall rollback test.
External caller identity used as role recipient, token recipient, token owner and transfer initiator.
Initial supply of 55555555555 * 10**18 is minted to msg.sender during initialize, concentrating supply and roles in one account.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, UPGRADER and APPROVER roles to msg.sender, giving full control to the initializer.
UUPS upgrade path performs a delegatecall into the new implementation (rollback test) after a role check, allowing arbitrary code execution in the proxy context.
Privileged write of an unbounded caller-controlled string into contract storage.
Parameter: arbitrary recipient address of mint().
Parameter: arbitrary amount of tokens created by mint().
Parameter: caller-supplied string written by setContractVersion.
Parameter: address of the new implementation passed to upgradeTo/_authorizeUpgrade.
Parameter: source account of _transfer.
Parameter: destination account of _transfer.
Parameter: amount moved by _transfer.
Local cache of the sender balance used for the unchecked subtraction in _transfer.
Local cache of the spender allowance used in the unchecked subtraction of transferFrom.

edges.reason: initialize() directly calls _mint(msg.sender, 55555555555 * 10 ** decimals()) creating the whole supply.
msg.sender is the recipient of the entire initial minted supply, tying untrusted input to a privileged minting operation.
initialize() calls _setupRole for DEFAULT_ADMIN, PAUSER, MINTER, UPGRADER and APPROVER with msg.sender.
msg.sender determines the beneficiary of all privilege grants performed during initialization.
Role setup writes membership entries into the _roles mapping.
PAUSER_ROLE is granted to msg.sender during initialization.
MINTER_ROLE is granted to msg.sender during initialization.
UPGRADER_ROLE is granted to msg.sender during initialization.
APPROVER_ROLE is granted to msg.sender during initialization although it guards nothing.
pause() is guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE) via the initializer-granted role.
unpause() is guarded by onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE).
mint() is guarded by onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE); whoever holds the role can create arbitrary tokens.
setContractVersion() is guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE).
_authorizeUpgrade() is guarded by onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE), protecting the proxy upgrade path.
The arbitrary 'to' argument flows into the privileged mint() function.
The arbitrary 'amount' argument flows into the privileged mint() function.
mint() forwards recipient and amount to the internal _mint routine.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply without any supply cap, allowing unbounded inflation by the MINTER_ROLE holder.
The caller-supplied version string flows into setContractVersion().
setContractVersion() performs the privileged storage write operation.
The storage write stores the caller-controlled string into _contractVersion.
getContractVersion() reads the _contractVersion state variable.
The new implementation address parameter is validated by the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
upgradeTo() must pass _authorizeUpgrade(), which enforces UPGRADER_ROLE before any upgrade.
Any external caller can reach upgradeTo() through the proxy; authorisation is deferred entirely to the role check in _authorizeUpgrade.
upgradeTo() triggers the delegatecall-based upgrade routine after authorisation.
The rollback test delegatecalls the new implementation which re-enters upgradeTo(oldImplementation) inside the proxy execution context.
The whenNotPaused modifier on _beforeTokenTransfer reads _paused, letting the PAUSER_ROLE holder halt all token movement.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
pause() sets the _paused flag to true.
unpause() resets the _paused flag to false.
msg.sender is the implicit owner whose balance is spent by transfer().
transfer() delegates the balance movement to internal _transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when reading and updating the allowance in transferFrom().
transferFrom() delegates the balance movement to internal _transfer.
msg.sender is the owner whose allowance is written by approve().
approve() writes the allowance entry into _allowances.
currentAllowance is subtracted from inside an unchecked block in transferFrom(), so the guard is the only overflow protection.
The sender parameter selects the balance slot debited in _transfer.
The recipient parameter selects the balance slot credited in _transfer.
The amount parameter determines the value moved in _transfer.
senderBalance is subtracted from inside an unchecked block in _transfer, relying solely on the preceding require.
_transfer mutates the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
grantRole() writes new members into the _roles mapping.
revokeRole() removes members from the _roles mapping.
grantRole() enforces onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) through _checkRole.
revokeRole() enforces onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) through _checkRole.
_checkRole reads the _roles mapping to decide whether the caller may proceed.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to feed the privileged mint() function and should be folded into it.
The 'amount' parameter only exists to feed the privileged mint() function and should be folded into it.
The 'version' parameter is only consumed by setContractVersion()'s storage write and should be folded into it.
The 'newImplementation' parameter is only consumed by the _authorizeUpgrade hook and should be folded into it.
The 'sender' parameter is only used to select the debited balance inside _transfer.
The 'recipient' parameter is only used to select the credited balance inside _transfer.
The transfer amount parameter is only used by the unchecked subtraction inside _transfer.
senderBalance is a transient local of _transfer's unchecked arithmetic and should be normalised into that function.
currentAllowance is a transient local of transferFrom()'s unchecked arithmetic and should be normalised into that function.
